name: Mushroom Musume
source:
Once upon a time, a lonesome recluse wished for a daughter. A witch overheard their wish, and instead granted them a pot of dirt. Play the role of the Hermit as you grow your adoptive child, and discover how many kinds of person (mushroom?) your daughter can be.

[edited from [url=https://mortallymoonstruckgames.itch.io/mushroom-musume]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从前，一位孤独的隐士许愿想要一个女儿。女巫无意间听到了这个愿望，却送给了他一盆泥土。在游戏中扮演隐士，培育你领养的孩子，看看你的女儿都能长成怎样的人（蘑菇？）吧。

[整编自[url=https://mortallymoonstruckgames.itch.io/mushroom-musume]Itch.io[/url]]
